slice_factorization.dead_slice: Delta_{s,t} = a[:,s] * b[t,:]^T for s != t

verdict.reason: The dead slice uses cross-channel outer products a[:,s] * b[t,:]^T, so summing Gamma-weighted dead coordinates is not a linear function of the Gamma-weighted live slices P_s and P_t. The single-term algebra provides rational/cross-ratio constraints, not a direct linear implication Gamma*Delta = 0 from Gamma*Eta = 0.
